g.text: louis-agent.core: one turn, step by step
ask the model to go on
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: A turn appends the message, asks the model, runs each tool call it asks for behind the guards, round after round, and appends the whole turn at the end.
Every request is written to the ledger, priced.
